drhp.business: Sai Parenteral is a diversified pharma formulations company operating in (i) Branded Generic Formulations sold under its own brands to government agencies, pharma companies, hospitals and super-stockists, and (ii) CDMO products & services (product development, validation, stability studies, dossiers, regulatory filings, commercial manufacturing) for domestic and international (Regulated and Semi-Regulated) markets. It owns 5 manufacturing facilities in India and acquired a 74.60% stake in Noumed Pharmaceuticals (Australia/NZ) in November 2025.
